create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with a dataloader, eval_unit, and optional callbacks list
run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to execute the evaluation loop using torchtnt evaluate
init_eval_runner_with_callbacks: initialize an EvalRunner with a dataloader, eval_unit, callbacks, and max_steps_per_epoch
save_eval_state: save the EvalRunner state to a checkpoint location during preemptions
load_eval_state: load the EvalRunner state from a checkpoint location to resume evaluation
